question: An invoice was settled by NEFT yesterday. How does it become paid in Kartavaya - do we take card payments on the portal?
note: A vocabulary case, not an intelligence one. There is no payment gateway in this product and there never will be: 'paid' only ever comes from bank reconciliation. A model that has not been told invents a gateway, because every other invoicing product it has read about has one - which is exactly why the block in front of it is the thing being measured. That block is glossary_terms/paid.md itself, injected by the same call the product makes, so the case measures the shipped words rather than a copy of them.
must_contain: does not have a payment gateway
